name: Staff Vertical Green / Blue
description: Staff master head lights GREEN whenever it points straight up (within ±20° of vertical-up, angle≈0°), and BLUE at all other angles. The angle→color decision runs locally on the Staff firmware (CMD_LED_VERTICAL preset, driven by its own IMU) — the engine only activates the preset once when the number starts; no further round-trips needed. The down-pointing pass (angle≈±180°, 'inverted') is intentionally NOT treated as vertical here.
